clauses.clause: If a source you control would deal damage to a permanent or player, it deals triple that damage to that permanent or player instead.
clauses.evidence: Stimulus 'an opponent's creature (opp_bear) dies' (probe deals 10 from you_giant): 'opp_bear is dealt 30 damage (by you_giant)'. Stimulus 'you_bear attacks': 'opp is dealt 6 damage (combat) (by you_bear)', opp 20 -> 14 from a 2/2. Stimulus 'on the opponent's turn, opp_bear attacks you': same as without the card (opponent's source not tripled). Replacement, not addition: the one damage event carries the tripled amount. Tree is the canonical B5b-repl-triple-damage. Pack fiery_emancipation_spell_source_tripled_opponents_not PASS: your Shock deals 6 to the opponent and 6 to your own 5/5 (dies), the opponent's Shock deals 2 to you.
